distribution.narrative: Cao et al. (2023) described Scolytus unicornis from Guomen Mountain, Nabanhe Nature Reserve, Menghai County, Jinghong City, Yunnan, establishing confirmed mainland-China occurrence in Yunnan.

host_note: The original description explicitly reports Ulmus sp.; adults were collected beneath bark of a dead elm. Host is retained at genus level and dead-tree condition is kept as ecological context.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytus unicornis Cao, Petrov & Wang, 2023.

taxonomic_history.name: Scolytus unicornis
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Scolytus unicornis Cao, Petrov & Wang was described as a new species in 2023. Original-description evidence maps directly to existing integrated taxonomic backbone identity VSN_5580; no duplicate VSN is created.
